Explosions Heard in Riyadh as Houthis Claim Missile Attack

Explosions were heard in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with smoke seen near the capital's main airport. The Houthi group claimed responsibility for a missile strike on the city, marking a target on Riyadh for the first time since an escalation against Saudi Arabia. The Saudi-led coalition stated that a ballistic missile was fired by the Houthis. Saudi Arabia reported intercepting the missile and later issued an all-clear. An emergency alert that was issued was lifted.
